SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.audience_type AS audienceType, p.grade_text AS gradeText, p.class_name_text AS classNameText, p.target_count AS targetCount, p.receiver_count AS receiverCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_message_receiver r WHERE r.message_id = p.message_id AND r.read_flag = 1) AS readCount, p.message_id AS messageId, p.sender, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.sent_at AS sentAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_activity_poster_image i WHERE i.poster_id = p.id) AS imageCount, (SELECT i.url FROM wx_activity_poster_image i WHERE i.poster_id = p.id ORDER BY i.sort_no, i.id LIMIT 1) AS coverUrl FROM wx_activity_poster p
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.sent_at >= #{start} AND p.sent_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY p.sent_at DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT id, url, sort_no AS sortNo FROM wx_activity_poster_image WHERE poster_id = #{posterId} ORDER BY sort_no, id
